title: Alloy Autonomous Inspection Surface
constitution: Every verb is read-only: no writes, no directory creation, no git-ref/index/worktree mutation, no network fetch, no package install, no process launch/stop/signal/recover, no application or browser launch, no credential loading, no deletion, no arbitrary command execution, and no execution of user-controlled configuration as shell. User configuration and runtime metadata are PARSED, never sourced. Unknown verbs and unsupported flags fail closed.

config_access.policy: parse-only, never sourced; fail closed on shell-active values

other: node lib/manifest-io.mjs get|project (fixed toolkit JSON reader; parses manifest fields, never sources, never writes)
node lib/engineering-io.mjs project-read (fixed toolkit JSON reader; reads initiative state.json, emits presentation-safe fields, never sources it, never writes)
date -u (read the clock for an evaluated_at stamp)

runtime_access.policy: observe, never control — Runtime Registry & Inspection V1

redaction.guarantee: secrets are physically unreachable — the field-restricted format never reads them

registry.written_by: alloy-runtime-register (explicit, mutating, OUTSIDE alloy-ro); alloy-ro never writes

intent_admission.phase: R2 — DECLARE (Runtime Intent & Admission Contract V1)
intent_admission.policy: declare, never actuate — admission is NOT provisioning; an admitted runtime may not yet exist
intent_admission.posture_source: <runtime-root>/manifests/<worktree>.json (canonical manifest; parsed via node lib/manifest-io.mjs get, never sourced)

intent_artifact.written_by: alloy-runtime-intent (explicit, mutating, identity-checked, OUTSIDE alloy-ro); alloy-ro never writes

root.summary: Classify a directory as canonical | managed-worktree | retired | unmanaged | outside and whether it is sanctioned.

runtime-paths.summary: Print resolved runtime path names (never secrets). Does not create directories.

worker-status.summary: Six-slot managed sprint status table. Never fetches (no --refresh).

agent-status.summary: Managed agent/slot detail for all slots or one target.

dev-status.summary: Dev-server / tracked-port listener status per managed worktree.

agent-evidence.summary: List evidence artifact names/sizes/mtimes for a slot. Never reads artifact contents; missing directory reads as empty.

worker-detail.summary: Extended per-worker metadata (role, session id, created/opened/closed, pause/finish, sprint objective). KV parsed, never sourced. No credential/token fields.

sprint-manifest.summary: Sprint manifest stage + initiative link for a worktree, via the fixed reader manifest-io.mjs get. Absent manifest reads as present:false.

initiatives.summary: All initiatives: key, state, title, timestamps, open-decision count, via the fixed reader engineering-io.mjs project-read.

initiative.summary: One initiative: state, title, and presentation-safe human decisions, via the fixed reader engineering-io.mjs project-read. Invalid/unknown key fails closed.

runtime-list.summary: Registered + discovered runtimes, reconciled. Observe only.

runtime-status.summary: One runtime: services, health, ports, inferred association.

runtime-capacity.summary: Configured vs observed active runtimes + aggregate memory/cpu. Observational; enforces nothing.

runtime-discover.summary: Live Docker discovery of Supabase runtime stacks (registry not consulted).

runtime-containers.summary: Redacted container list for a runtime. Never emits command/env/secrets.

runtime-policy.summary: Canonical posture->isolation mapping and admission policy (static + configured max). Declares, never actuates.

runtime-admission.summary: Live, ephemeral admission decision for a worktree from manifest posture + observed capacity. Admission is NOT provisioning; nothing is reserved, started, or attached.

runtime-intent.summary: Inspect a recorded runtime intent (parsed, never sourced) or report none. A recorded intent is a declaration, not a provisioned runtime.

runtime-explain.summary: Separate views: posture resolution, admission decision, and actual observed runtime state. Does not imply an admitted runtime exists.

runtime-reservations.summary: R3 capacity reservation records (control-plane claims). Read-only; the mutating executor alloy-runtime-actuate is OUTSIDE alloy-ro and never reachable here.

runtime-executions.summary: R3 execution lifecycle records (state, typed result, retryable, desired-state-reached). Read-only; contains no secrets or provider output.

runtime-actuation-capacity.summary: Reservation-aware capacity overlay: configured max, observed active, held reservation units, effective remaining. R2 owns the max/active formula; R3 only subtracts live held reservations. Read-only.

excluded_from_surface.note: These remain their own commands and continue to require explicit human approval. They are unreachable through alloy-ro.
